Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2412
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional.
Observed successes:
- C accepted: small claim, east; large invoice, north.
Observed failures:
- C rejected: small claim north; small shipment east/north; large shipment east/north; large refund south/east.
- B rejected: large claim south; large refund east.
- A untested.
Patterns:
- Do not route shipments or refunds to C; all C attempts there failed.
- Claims: C works for small east, failed for small north. B failed for large south.
- Invoices: C works for large north.
Caveat: outcome text sometimes names a different option than the action taken (e.g., action B but says “C not valid”; action C but says “B not valid”). Trust the action/result pairing more than the rejection wording.
Next decision guidance:
- If request matches known success (small claim east; large invoice north), choose C.
- Otherwise, avoid C for shipment/refund; test A or B.
- B failed for large claim south and large refund east, so prefer A for those unless new evidence.
- Collect outcomes for A, and for B/C on remaining type-region-size combinations.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2422
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional.
Caveat: outcome wording can name the wrong option; trust action/result pairing.

Confirmed successes:
- C: small claim east; large claim east; large invoice north.
- A: large shipment south.

Confirmed failures:
- C: small claim north; shipments small/large east/north; refunds south/east; large refund east.
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipment east/south; small claim south/north; small refund east.
- B: large claim south; large refund east.

Guidance:
- Claims: choose C for small or large east. C failed small north; A failed small north/south and large east/south; B failed large south. Large south unknown after A/B fail — test C. Small south — test B/C.
- Invoices: choose C for large north. Large east: A failed; test B or C.
- Shipments: avoid C. Use A for large south. A failed small east/south; test B for other shipments.
- Refunds: avoid C. A failed small east; B failed large east. Test B for small east/south; C unknown elsewhere.
- Collect outcomes for A/B/C on remaining type-region-size combinations, especially claims south, invoices east, shipments small non-south, and refunds.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2432
Caveat: +0.00 = chosen action failed; +1.00 = succeeded. Ignore option names in outcome wording.

Confirmed successes:
- C: small claim east; large claim east; small invoice east.
- A: large shipment south; large refund north.
- B: small shipment east (one success, but see conflict).

Confirmed failures:
- C: small claim north; large claim north; large claim south; large invoice north; shipments east/north (small/large); refunds south/east; large refund east.
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipment east/south; small claim south/north; small refund east.
- B: large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east; large shipment north; small shipment east (conflicts with later success).

Contradictions:
- Small shipment east: B failed at REQ-2428 but succeeded at REQ-2431. Treat B as unstable there; retest if needed.
- Large invoice north: old C success contradicted by new C failure at REQ-2430. Treat as unresolved, not C.

Guidance:
- Claims: C works small/large east. C fails north and large south. Large claim south has failed under A, B, and C. Small south: A failed; test B/C.
- Invoices: small east — use C; B failed. Large north — C failed; test A/B. Large east — A failed; test B/C.
- Shipments: avoid C. A works large south. Small east is mixed/unclear. Test B for other shipments, especially non-south.
- Refunds: A works large north. Avoid C. A failed small east. B failed large east. Test B for small east/south.

Collect outcomes for claims south, invoices large north/east, shipments small non-south, refunds small.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2442  
Caveat: +0.00 = chosen action failed; +1.00 = succeeded. Ignore option names in outcome wording.

Confirmed successes:
- C: small/large claim east; small claim south; small invoice east; small invoice north.
- A: large shipment south; large refund north; small refund north.
- B: small shipment east (one success only; otherwise failed).

Confirmed failures:
- C: small/large claim north; large claim south; small invoice south; large invoice east; shipments east/north (small/large); refunds south/east; large refund east.
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipment east/south; small claim south/north; small refund east.
- B: small claim south; large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east; large shipment north/east; small shipment east (failed REQ-2428, REQ-2440; succeeded REQ-2431 — treat as unstable).

Contradictions:
- Small shipment east, B: failed, succeeded, then failed again. Treat B as unreliable here.
- Large invoice north: old C success contradicted by C failure REQ-2430; unresolved.

Guidance:
- Claims: C works small/large east and small south. C fails north and large south. Large claim south has failed under A/B/C. Small south: B failed, C works.
- Invoices: small east/north use C; B failed small east. Small south C failed; test A/B. Large north unresolved; test A/B. Large east A and C failed; test B. Large south no valid A/B/C data.
- Shipments: avoid C. A works large south. Small east B unstable; A also failed earlier. Test carefully, especially non-south.
- Refunds: A works large north and small north. Avoid C. A failed small east. B failed large east. Test B for small east/south.

Collect outcomes for: large claim south, invoices large north/east/south and small south, shipments small non-south, refunds small east/south.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2452  
Caveat: +1.00 = success; +0.00 = failure. Use “did” option; ignore option names in outcome text. D/invalid options ignored.

Confirmed successes:
- C: small/large claim east (now unstable); small invoice east/north. Prior C small claim south now contradicted.
- A: large shipment south/north; large refund north/east; small refund north.
- B: small shipment south. B small shipment east unstable (one success, later failures).

Confirmed failures:
- C: small/large claim north; large claim south; small invoice south; large invoice east; shipments east/north; refunds south/east/large east. C large claim east failed REQ-2450. C small claim south failed REQ-2452.
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipment east/south; small claim south/north; small refund east; small invoice south REQ-2448.
- B: small claim south; large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east; large shipment north/east; large invoice east REQ-2447. Small shipment east failed/succeeded/failed.

Contradictions/unresolved:
- C large claim east and C small claim south: prior success vs new failure. Treat C there as unreliable.
- Large invoice north: C success vs C failure REQ-2430.
- Small shipment east B unreliable.

Guidance:
- Claims: large south failed A/B/C. Small south A/B/C failed/unstable. C east now unreliable. Need fresh tests.
- Invoices: small east/north use C. Small south: C and A failed; test B. Large north unresolved; test A/B. Large east: A/B/C failed; avoid/flag. Large south no A/B/C data.
- Shipments: avoid C. A works large north/south. B works small south. Small east B unstable; A failed. Test small non-south cautiously.
- Refunds: A works large north/east, small north. Avoid C. A failed small east. B failed large east. Test B small east/south.

Collect outcomes for: invoices small south (B), large north/east/south; shipments small non-south; refunds small east/south; claims large east/south, small south.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2459  
Caveat: +1.00 success; +0.00 failure. Use “did” option; ignore option names in outcome text. D/invalid options ignored.

Confirmed successes:
- A: large shipment south; large refund north/east; small refund north.
- C: small/large claim east (unreliable); small invoice east/north.
- B: small shipment south.

Confirmed failures:
- C: small/large claim north; large claim south; small invoice south; large invoice east; shipments east/north; refunds south/east/large east. C large claim east failed REQ-2450; C small claim south failed REQ-2452.
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipment east/south; small claim south/north; small refund east; small invoice south. A large shipment north failed REQ-2458 (prior success).
- B: small claim south; large claim south; large claim east REQ-2455; large refund east; small invoice east; large shipment north/east; small refund east REQ-2456. Small shipment east unreliable.

Contradictions/unresolved:
- C large claim east / C small claim south: prior success vs new failure; unreliable.
- Large invoice north: C success vs C failure.
- A large shipment north: prior success vs REQ-2458 failure.
- B small shipment east unreliable.
- D rows ignored.

Guidance:
- Claims: large south failed A/B/C. Small south A/B/C failed/unstable. C east unreliable. Large east now failed A/B/C; avoid/flag. Small east/north A failed. Need fresh tests.
- Invoices: small east/north use C. Small south: C/A failed; test B. Large north unresolved; test A/B. Large east A/B/C failed; avoid/flag. Large south no A/B/C data.
- Shipments: avoid C. A works large south; north now unstable. B works small south. Small east B unstable; A failed. Test small non-south cautiously.
- Refunds: A works large north/east, small north. Avoid C. A failed small east. B failed small east/large east. Test B small south.

Collect outcomes for: invoices small south (B), large north/south; shipments small non-south; refunds small south; claims large south.
